conventions.useCaseLayout: packages/scheduling uses flat application/*.use-case.ts next to *.use-case.test.ts
conventions.assert: Call the subject the way its users do. Assert literal status, code, ISO instants, and row counts. Do not assert mock call counts alone.

httpStatusGaps.note: apps/api/src/http/errors.ts statusForFailureCode. These create codes would currently map to 500 if exposed over HTTP.

tests.name: persists an open request with its normalized initial proposal and emits one event
tests.given: A pending Encounter snapshot and reschedule.request allowed
tests.when: CreateScheduleChangeRequestUseCase.execute with a future proposedStartAt and reason
tests.then: status is open, one proposal, one scheduling.reschedule-requested, snapshot scheduledStartAt unchanged

tests.name: accepts an existing OfficialMatch slot without changing the Encounter schedule
tests.then: request saved, encounter scheduledStartAt unchanged

tests.name: requires the contextual reschedule-request permission
tests.then: error code authorization.forbidden, permission encounters.reschedule.request, zero rows

tests.name: blocks a Team that reached the applied-reschedule limit
tests.then: code scheduling.reschedule_limit_reached, instance RescheduleLimitReached

tests.name: counts applied reschedules for the requested Encounter instead of the Team globally
tests.given: another encounter at the limit, this encounter at 0
tests.then: create succeeds

tests.name: returns the original request for an identical idempotent replay without another event
tests.then: same request object, rows length 1, events length 1

tests.name: POST schedule-change-requests returns the open request and does not move the snapshot clock
tests.given: service auth, actor with encounters.reschedule.request, a fixture-backed encounter
tests.when: POST /api/v1/encounters/:encounterId/schedule-change-requests with scope, proposedStartAt ISO, reason, idempotencyKey
tests.then: 201, body.status === "open", GET schedule-snapshot scheduledStartAt equals the pre-create instant

tests.name: POST without reschedule.request returns 403 authorization.forbidden
tests.then: status 403, body.code === "authorization.forbidden"

tests.name: second incompatible POST returns 409 scheduling.active_schedule_change_request_exists
tests.when: POST another request on the same encounter
tests.then: 409 and code scheduling.active_schedule_change_request_exists (requires statusForFailureCode update or the test fails with 500)

tests.name: GET schedule-change-requests lists the open request for that encounter only
tests.given: open request on encounter A and encounter B
tests.then: 200, array length 1, id equals A's request id

tests.name: POST without INTERNAL_JOB_SECRET returns 401
tests.then: 401 api.unauthorized

tests.name: saving two requests with the same organizationId and idempotencyKey does not insert a second row
tests.given: Postgres or in-memory adapter with UNIQUE (organization_id, idempotency_key)
tests.when: save then save with same key
tests.then: findByIdempotencyKey returns the first id

tests.name: createScheduleChangeRequest posts the contract body to the encounter collection
tests.then: method POST, URL ends with /encounters/enc-1/schedule-change-requests, parsed status "open"

tests.name: listScheduleChangeRequests GETs the encounter collection
tests.then: GET that path, result [ { id: "req-1", status: "open" } ]

tests.name: acceptScheduleChangeRequest posts to the accept sub-resource
tests.then: POST .../schedule-change-requests/req-1/accept, parsed status "accepted"

tests.name: createScheduleChangeRequest does not PATCH fixture encounters
tests.then: recorded path does not contain /fixtures/

tasks.title: [UI] Flujo capitán: solicitar reprogramación
tasks.criterios: UI capitán solicita fecha; TZ; loading/error.

tests.name: captain submit posts entire_encounter with the chosen instant and reason
tests.given: useCan reschedule.request true, competition timeZone America/Lima
tests.then: mutation body.proposedStartAt is the UTC ISO for that Lima wall time, body.reason is the typed string, loading then success

tests.name: shows the typed invalid date error from scheduling.invalid_schedule_change_date
tests.then: accessible alert text is the es/en message for that code, not a raw stack

tests.name: does not offer Reprogramar when useCan is false
tests.then: no button named Reprogramar

tests.name: approved OfficialMatch shows a disabled control with a reason (UX-SCH-004)
tests.then: control disabled, reason text present

tests.name: datetime field labels America/Lima
tests.then: visible text includes America/Lima

tests.name: rival accept shows accepted and the new clock in the competition zone
tests.given: open request, actor on the opposite team, permission allowed
tests.then: status text accepted, displayed time matches proposal instant in competition TZ

tests.name: rival reject leaves the snapshot clock unchanged
tests.then: status rejected, fixture time still the original ISO rendered

tests.name: counter appends a proposal that appears in history
tests.when: submit a later instant and reason
tests.then: history shows two rows, latest reason equals the typed string

tests.name: accept on a no-longer-open request shows the tagged error code
tests.then: alert uses that code's message, actions disabled

tests.name: Schedule tab empty state when the encounter has no requests
tests.then: empty copy visible, no crash

tasks.title: [Domain] Apply fecha al fixture + historial
tasks.criterios: Apply al fixture; historial; sin doble apply.

tests.name: reschedules a pending encounter, bumps revision, and records one audit entry
tests.when: edit then replay same requestId with a different date
tests.then: clock stays on the first instant, one audit row, one encounter-rescheduled

tests.name: accept moves EncounterScheduleSnapshot.scheduledStartAt to the latest proposal instant
tests.then: snapshot scheduledStartAt getTime() === Date.parse("2026-09-22T21:00:00.000Z"), request.status === "accepted"

tests.name: second accept of the same request does not emit a second encounter-rescheduled
tests.when: accept again with the same actor
tests.then: events filter eventName scheduling.encounter-rescheduled has length 1, snapshot still the accepted instant

tests.name: accept of official_match slot 2 does not change slot 1 start (AC-SCH-001)
tests.given: per-slot starts exist, slot 1 20:00Z, slot 2 request to 22:00Z
tests.then: slot 1 start 20:00Z, slot 2 start 22:00Z. Blocked until official_matches.scheduled_start_at or equivalent exists.

tests.name: accept increments countAppliedReschedules for the requesting team on that encounter
tests.then: countAppliedReschedules returns 1. A third create after two accepts returns scheduling.reschedule_limit_reached

tests.name: encounter-rescheduled payload.scope matches the request scope
tests.then: payload.scope equals { type: "official_match", officialSlot: 2 }, previousStartAt and newStartAt are ISO strings

tasks.title: [Domain] Reglas de zona horaria en reprogramaciones
tasks.criterios: TZ de competición; sin ambigüedad UTC.

tests.name: preserves the competition wall-clock time across daylight-saving changes
tests.then: round starts keep the same local wall time across the spring-forward

tests.name: proposal proposedStartAt equals the UTC epoch for the competition wall time
tests.given: competition zone America/Lima, client wants 2026-09-20 20:00 local
tests.then: saved.proposals[0].proposedStartAt.toISOString() === "2026-09-21T01:00:00.000Z" and event payload.proposedStartAt is that same string

tests.name: a past date / the current Encounter date / an invalid date
tests.when: proposedStartAt invalid, past, or equal to current start
tests.then: code scheduling.invalid_schedule_change_date

tests.name: a local wall time that does not exist in the competition zone is invalid
tests.when: create after interpreting in that zone
tests.then: code scheduling.invalid_schedule_change_date. Requires a zoned input or interpreter that does not currently exist.

tests.name: POST with proposedStartAt lacking an offset returns api.validation_error
tests.then: 400 api.validation_error, use case not invoked

tests.name: proposal inside minimumRescheduleNoticeHours of kickoff is rejected
tests.given: notice 12, kickoff in 6 hours in America/Lima
tests.then: typed date or notice error. Rules port does not expose notice hours today.

tests.name: open request past proposal TTL becomes expired
tests.then: status === "expired". Inject ClockPort. Do not sleep.

tests.name: open request 11h59m after create stays open
tests.then: status === "open"

tests.name: expired request becomes escalated
tests.then: status === "escalated"

tests.name: actor without encounters.reschedule.resolve cannot organizer-resolve
tests.then: authorization.forbidden, permission encounters.reschedule.resolve, snapshot unchanged

tests.name: escalated request still conflicts with a new create on the same scope
tests.then: scheduling.active_schedule_change_request_exists. Today the fake treats only open as active.

tests.name: after DEC-034 deadline a captain create is rejected and staff create is allowed
tests.given: deadline field exists and clock is past it
tests.then: captain typed reject, staff succeeds. Field does not exist yet.

tasks.title: [QA] Carreras de aceptación concurrente de reprogramación

tests.name: serializes concurrent requests so only one active request is created
tests.when: Promise.all two creates on overlapping scopes
tests.then: exactly one ok, one ActiveScheduleChangeRequestExists, rows length 1, events length 1

tests.name: holds a transaction-bound Encounter lock across concurrent read-check-save operations
tests.then: one ok, one conflict, one row

tests.name: two concurrent accepts yield one accepted clock and one typed error
tests.given: one open request, two rival actors, shared lock and transaction
tests.when: Promise.all accept A and accept B
tests.then: one status accepted, snapshot equals the proposal instant, one scheduling.encounter-rescheduled, loser code is a 409-mapped tagged error

tests.name: same actor accept twice is idempotent
tests.when: accept again with the same actor and payload
tests.then: ok, same request id, events length 1, snapshot unchanged on the second call

tests.name: accept concurrent with counter has one winner
tests.then: exactly one mutation of proposals or status, the other a typed not-open or conflict error, fixture clock matches the winner

tests.name: accept concurrent with EditFixtureEncounterUseCase on the same encounter
tests.given: open request and staff PATCH payload
tests.then: one clock, loser FixtureUpdateConflict or request not-open, one encounter-rescheduled

tests.name: two Postgres transactions on one encounterId do not both apply a schedule change
tests.given: DATABASE_URL, PostgresEncounterMutationLock, two pools or connections
tests.then: one commit with the new instant, the other conflict. Skip when DATABASE_URL is unset.
